title: In Argentina, a family rescued 5,000 ancient olive trees from development and built a sanctuary instead of letting them become firewood
description: In Mendoza, ancient olive trees are threatened by urban growth, resulting in many being chopped for firewood. To combat this, the Cicero family has successfully relocated over five thousand of these historic trees to a dedicated sanctuary.
